author: Tizianop6
body:
#### PR description:

Introduction of the MergedCluster object for MTD reconstruction and simulation. 

The MergedCluster object is introduced for MTD, the goal of this object is to aid in the reconstruction and validation of extended particle signature in BTL, both for MIP interactions and more complex phenomena. Development done by Petra Akrap, Noemi Palmeri, Tiziano Pauletto, with the guidance of the MTD DPG conveners Fabio Cossutti and Martina Malberti. With the help of Filippo Errico, Francesco Santanastasio, Livia Soffi .  

On the reco side: the FTLMergedCluster object is introduced, which takes the existing FTLCluster collection and merges the clusters that are split among different BTL Sensor Modules and satisfy a timing requirement, under assumption that they originate from the same particle. The attributes of the FTLMergedClusters are computed starting from the constituent FTLClusters. The producer is applied for both BTL and ETL, the changes affect only the BTL clusters. 

On the SIM side: the MtdSimMergedCluster object is introduced, it is created through the merging of MtdSimLayerClusters that are topologically (overlapping, or adjacent, in the case of clusters lying at the edge of Sensor Modules) and historically related.  Topologically related direct MtdSimMergedClusters are merged if they are matched to the same TrackingParticle. Topologically related indirect MtdSimMergedClusters are merged together if they have a common ancestor in the history of simulated particles that have generated them. Backscatter MtdSimMergedClusters are kept isolated and merged only among themselves. Topologically related direct and indirect MtdSimMergedClusters are merged together on the basis of the common ancestor criterion. 

The FTLMergedCluster is the new reference object for the reconstruction in MTD. The MTDTrackingRecHit is constructed starting from it and the track->time assignment is done using the FTLMergedCluster information. The MtdSimMergedCluster object is the new reference for the truth object in MTD, all the validation modules have been changed to use these two objects. 

Association maps are introduced between TrackingParticles <-> MtdSimMergedCluster and  between MtdSimMergedCluster <-> FTLMergedClusters.
The MtdSimMergedCluster <-> FTLMergedClusters association maps leverage the already existing MtdSimLayerCluster <-> FTLClusters  association maps, in which the time & energy compatibility requirements have been removed. Those requirements are now put at validation level (in BtlLocalRecoValidation). The removal of the association map requirements affects both BTL and ETL Clusters.


  - what changes are expected in the output if any: 

In terms of DQM plots: removal of local x/y resolution plots from BtlLocalRecoValidation: local position can become ambiguous in the case of different SMs between reco and sim. Addition of plots in the same plugin in order to study energy/time compatibility between matched RECO -> SIM MergedClusters. 
New 1D plots are produced in the MergedClusterValidation plugin to characterize the new objects.
